data.offering_description: Mines and supplies frac sand, and provides logistics that move and store it, to oil and gas producers and well-completion service companies. It makes money by selling sand and charging for transport, transloading and storage at terminals near drilling areas.

data.primary_services: proppant logistics; transloading; last-mile delivery; storage at terminals

data.customer_segment: B2B: oil and gas exploration and production companies, pressure pumping service companies

data.revenue_model: product sales: frac sand sold to well operators and pumping companies; service fees: fees for sand transport, transloading and terminal storage

data.value_chain_position: raw materials: mined sand supplied to completion crews, sold to oil and gas operators and pumpers; service provider: logistics and terminal services moving sand to wellsites, sold to operators and pumpers

data.geography_served: US national: Permian, Haynesville, Appalachian and Mid-Continent oil and gas basins

data.specialization: related lines: frac sand supply and proppant logistics services that share oilfield customers and terminals

data.distribution_channels: direct sales: sand contracts with exploration and production companies and pressure pumpers; own locations: company-operated mine and transload and storage terminals

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: mining and environmental permits, workplace safety and transport rules from state agencies and federal mine safety regulators

data.offering_description: Mines, processes and sells raw and dried frac sand (proppant) to oil and natural gas exploration and production companies and oilfield service companies. It operates mines and processing plants in Wisconsin and delivers sand by rail and through last-mile logistics and wellsite storage solutions. It also sells industrial sand for non-oilfield uses.

data.primary_services: last-mile sand logistics; wellsite sand storage systems; rail transloading

data.customer_segment: B2B: oil and gas exploration and production companies, pressure pumping and oilfield service companies, industrial sand buyers

data.end_markets: oil and natural gas exploration and production; industrial sand applications

data.revenue_model: product sales: frac sand sold under long-term take-or-pay contracts and spot sales; service fees: last-mile logistics and wellsite storage services

data.value_chain_position: raw materials: mines and processes sand from owned reserves, sold to oilfield service and E&P firms; service provider: last-mile delivery and wellsite storage for customers

data.geography_served: US national: Mines in Wisconsin, serves Permian, Eagle Ford, Marcellus/Utica, Bakken, Rockies and Mid-Continent basins, some Canadian exposure

data.specialization: related lines: frac sand production, industrial sand, and last-mile logistics and storage

data.distribution_channels: direct sales: direct contracts with E&P and oilfield service customers, delivered by unit-train rail and trucking

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: mining safety (MSHA), silica dust exposure (OSHA), and environmental and permitting rules

P2.2.text: Smart Sand Industrial Product Solutions At SmartSand, we proudly own and operate four premium northern white sand mines, spanning from the St. Peter to the Wonewoc formations. Our extensive product range, from 8/16 to 100GFN, ensures

P2.4.text: At SmartSand, we proudly own and operate four premium northern white sand mines, spanning from the St. Peter to the Wonewoc formations. Our extensive product range, from 8/16 to 100GFN, ensures we meet all your sand needs.

P2.5.text: Diverse Product Selection: From coarse to fine grains, we have it all.

P2.6.text: Extensive Shipping Network: With access to 6 railroads, we deliver across the USA, Canada, and Mexico.

P2.7.text: Flexible Loading and Shipping Options: We offer loading and shipping via “Bulk bag, 3000#”, high-speed truck loading for both pneumatic and bottom dump, and bulk shipping via rail.

P2.8.text: Custom Solutions: Offering custom blending and in-house packaging to suit your specific requirements.

P2.9.text: SmartSand is dedicated to the industrial market, ensuring a consistent, long-term supply of high-quality sand at competitive prices. Our industrial team, boasting over 100 years of combined experience, is committed to providing exceptional products to markets worldwide. Utilizing in-house state of the art technology for gradation, ADV, pH, LOI, Moisture, and XRF (Powder/Pellet).

P2.10.text: Our rapid expansion is a testament to our strategic commitment and the trust our customers place in us. Partnering with SmartSand means discovering a new way of doing business, one that sets you apart from the competition.

data.offering_description: Provides mobile gas-turbine and reciprocating power generation fleets, rented on contract to data centers, utilities and industrial customers. Also manufactures and rents proppant-handling equipment (mobile storage and conveyance systems) to oil and gas well completion operators. Equipment is built at its own facilities and deployed and serviced by company crews.
